newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shanghai Ind signs US$300 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Ind signs US$300 mln loan.

text.p: Shanghai Industrial Holdings's US$300 million loan facility was signed, the company said on Thursday.
The facility has a final maturity of five years, with amortising repayment and a three-year grace period.
The loan pays an interest margin of 60 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
Proceeds are to be used for general working purposes.
A total of 21 banks joined the syndication.
Lead arrangers are HSBC Investment Bank Asia, and Chase Manhattan Asia.
Currently, the company has 11 entities involved in the manufacturing of consumer products, commercial retail, infrastructure development and the vehicle industry.
